coverage: Whole group · one reported asset management business
definition: The group’s profit after expenses and tax. It includes the effect of income from the company’s own investments and is not the return earned by mutual fund investors.
incomeDefinition: Income from managing investments and related work. This is separate from other income in the company’s accounts and does not include the money invested by customers.
sourceLabel: Audited consolidated results filed with the exchanges
location: PDF page 12, annual audited consolidated income statement; PDF page 15, notes 7–10
notes: Revenue from operations excludes ₹500.04 crore of other income. The year’s profit includes a ₹46.81 crore reduction in tax expense after the company rechecked an amount it had previously set aside for earlier years’ income tax. This was not a fee from a customer. The accounts show all profit attributable to owners of the parent. No separate profit is reported for share funds, debt funds or individual schemes.
insight: The fees the manager earns and the investments it manages are different measures. The total is for the business that manages money, not for the individual funds it runs.
